need: Idle git worktrees whose work was never merged are preserved (ref and verified bundle) and their worktree removed automatically, keeping the branch, so they stop filling the disk.

searched.query: remove unmerged worktree, archive ref, git bundle
searched.found: lane_sweep removes only lanes whose content is on main; prune-merged-worktrees likewise needs proof the branch landed; the 2026-11-09 world-substrate script did refs/archive/<date>/<branch> plus a verified bundle by hand, the procedure adopted here.

searched.where: git documentation (git-worktree, git-bundle, git-update-ref) and common worktree managers, from the agent's knowledge, not looked up on 2026-11-19
searched.query: expire stale worktrees, archive unmerged branches
searched.found: git worktree prune only drops records of folders already deleted; git gc keeps unreachable commits only for the reflog expiry; no stock tool archives and removes idle unmerged worktrees.

candidates.name: git bundle and git update-ref (built into git)
candidates.covers: A verifiable offline copy of the unmerged commits and a ref that keeps them reachable.
candidates.misses: Deciding which lanes are idle, unused and clean; lane_sweep already does that.
candidates.reason: Both parts exist; lane_sweep adds one step before its removal.

candidates.name: git worktree prune / gc.worktreePruneExpire
candidates.covers: Removing worktree records whose folders are gone.
candidates.misses: Removing folders that still exist, and preserving their commits.

candidates.name: Push every lane branch to GitHub instead
candidates.covers: An off-machine copy of every tip.
candidates.misses: Public repositories would publish work never chosen for publication; other owners' remotes are not Brian's to write to.
candidates.reason: Kept only as the optional push to a private repository of the configured owner.
